baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired forms of س ك ن in 'house them from where you dwell' are immediately bounded by the prohibitions on harming and constricting them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Housing is an act of transferring settledness: the same dwelling field occupied by the addressee must provide an actual cessation of displacement for the women, scaled to real capacity. The paired harm and constriction clauses prevent nominal shelter from being engineered into spatial or psychological pressure.

activation_trace.role: Cessation of motion makes settledness, not merely an address, the operative result of the housing command.
Dwelling in a home supplies the concrete residential domain in which that settledness must be realized.
The initially indeterminate place is resolved by the addressee's own dwelling situation, tying provision to lived spatial reality.
Material amplitude and ability calibrate what can be supplied without turning capacity into permission to make the space unlivable.
Deliberate or reciprocal injury identifies coercive treatment as a prohibited housing mechanism.
Making a place unable to contain its occupant specifies how formally supplied housing can still function as expulsion pressure.

changed_reading.before: Supply a residence and refrain from an additional overt injury.
changed_reading.after: Produce a genuinely settling residential zone proportionate to actual means; intentionally compressing that zone until it drives her out is itself the prohibited injury.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Pregnancy, spending until delivery, nursing, giving wages, and possible replacement nursing form one ordered sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah tracks an embodied load through a state change: an interior burden requires expenditure until it is laid down, after which milk transfer becomes a distinct service answered by payment. Support follows the location of load and labor rather than disappearing with the marital bond.

activation_trace.role: The inward bodily load establishes the first support-bearing state and its repeated endpoint.
The required outward movement of wealth answers the continuing inward burden.
Delivery is the explicit state transition at which the pregnancy load is put down.
Milk transfer supplies the post-delivery labor that must continue whether performed by the mother or another woman.
Giving makes compensation a directed transfer to the nursing woman rather than an implicit household residue.
Remuneration marks nursing as compensable work after the pregnancy-support phase.

changed_reading.before: Pregnancy support, delivery, nursing, and wages are neighboring family-law instructions.
changed_reading.after: They are a transfer chain: resources accompany gestational load to delivery, then compensation accompanies whoever performs the next embodied care task.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mutual consultation in recognized good is followed, without requiring restored intimacy, by another nurse when the parties mutually harden matters.
baseline_models.mechanism: Consultation creates a relational bridge across separation, while recognized good supplies a standard larger than either party's preference. If reciprocal obstruction closes that bridge, the ayah changes the worker but preserves the nursing function; deadlock activates failover rather than coercion or care interruption.

activation_trace.role: Mutual deliberation and acceptance of counsel supply the decision process for post-separation care.
A connection maintained between separate parties makes consultation possible without erasing their separation.
Recognized good constrains bargaining by a socially and morally intelligible standard.
Reciprocal twisting and obstruction describe a failed coordination process, not merely external poverty.
The unchanged milk-feeding function is the continuity target on both sides of the deadlock.
A different woman becomes the alternate performer while the child's care remains continuous.

changed_reading.before: The parents should agree amicably, otherwise the father may hire someone else.
changed_reading.after: The ayah specifies a resilient care protocol: negotiate under an external norm, but when reciprocal obstruction makes that channel fail, reroute the task without forcing reunion or stopping care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The means clause, commanded expenditure, ban on narrowed livelihood, and explicit nursing wage all regulate resource movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Resources are treated as a bounded flow rather than a one-time possession. Capacity sets the inlet, expenditure and wages create directed outlets, and the anti-constriction clause bars the provider from throttling those outlets to gain leverage.

activation_trace.role: Available wealth and ability define the real capacity feeding the support flow.
The image of depletion keeps the provider's finite stock visible rather than presuming limitless liability.
Expenditure directs part of that finite stock toward dependents.
Constriction of livelihood identifies strategic underfunding as a mode of pressure.
The named wage prevents nursing labor from becoming an invisible or blocked outlet.

changed_reading.before: The verse states several amounts or payments without fixing their size.
changed_reading.after: It governs a finite support circuit: actual capacity limits flow, while anti-harm and named compensation prevent deliberate throttling of shelter, subsistence, or care wages.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier non-expulsion rule calls the residences 'their houses,' places them inside marked boundaries, and leaves room for a new event to arise. This strengthens focus housing as a protected interval that preserves future options, not a revocable favor in the provider's space.

activation_trace.role: Concrete inhabitation anchors the focus command in an actual home rather than nominal access.
Movement to the exterior supplies the exact displacement that the doubled prohibition blocks.
Shelter as home gives the women a recognized residential position during the interval.
A distinguishing barrier marks non-expulsion as a boundary on discretionary control.
The possibility of something coming into being makes protected residence a holder of still-open outcomes.

structural_cues: 65:1 doubles the exit prohibition around 'their houses' before saying that a new matter may arise afterward.
65:6 answers that earlier non-expulsion with a positive command to cause dwelling and a ban on coercive constriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-exit, home, boundary, and a possible newly arising event; I infer that secure residence preserves legal and relational possibilities during transition. A live narrower alternative is that 65:1 supplies only waiting-period procedure without a future-preservation rationale.

changed_reading.before: Housing is temporary accommodation supplied from the former husband's resources.
changed_reading.after: Housing is a bounded, non-revocable transition space recognized as hers in use, kept stable so pressure cannot prematurely close the futures that the waiting interval leaves open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier option to retain or separate under the same recognized-good standard is made witnessed, just, and upright. It changes focus consultation from private cordiality into a decision procedure that remains norm-governed and reviewable even when the relationship has divided.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation supplies the cooperative procedure whose quality the context makes publicly assessable.
Recognized good is the shared standard governing the terms of care.
A clean distinction between parties shows that procedural cooperation can persist across actual separation.
Present observation makes consequential decisions visible beyond the bargaining pair.
Justice in judgment supplies the criterion by which the witnessed arrangement can be assessed.
Making testimony stand straight contributes procedural integrity rather than mere documentation.

structural_cues: 65:2 repeats بمعروف for both retention and separation, then immediately requires witnesses and established testimony.
65:6 repeats the same standard inside consultation over nursing and wages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, repeated recognized good, witnessing, justice, and upright testimony; I infer that focus consultation should produce terms capable of fair external review. A live alternative is that witnessing applies only to the divorce decision and does not formally extend to nursing arrangements.

changed_reading.before: Consult together politely and settle nursing terms informally.
changed_reading.after: Use a norm-bound procedure whose care and wage terms remain intelligible, just, and potentially attestable after separation; friendliness alone is not the safeguard.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence joins provision from an unreckoned place, accounting, sufficiency, and determined measure. It revises 'from your means' into accountable but non-closed capacity: support is measured in reality, yet a self-serving forecast cannot exhaust what routes of provision or sufficiency are possible.

activation_trace.role: An indeterminate place resolved by its clause anchors the focus obligation in the actual dwelling channel.
Real wealth and ability remain the concrete capacity term that must be assessed.
An apportioned gift arriving through an unanticipated route keeps provision from being reduced to the provider's prediction.
Counting supplies the calculative frame that the phrase 'does not reckon' explicitly marks as limited.
Sufficiency supplies a functional endpoint distinct from merely reporting current assets.
Determinate measure prevents openness to provision from becoming a claim of limitless means.

structural_cues: 65:3 and 65:6 repeat من حيث, but the former pairs it with what is not reckoned while the latter pairs it with lived dwelling and means.
The same 65:3 unit closes with a measure assigned to every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unanticipated provision, failed reckoning, sufficiency, and measure; I infer that capacity must be honestly measured without treating a strategic estimate as predictive closure. A live alternative is a strictly static reading in which وجد is only the payer's presently demonstrable assets.

changed_reading.before: The payer's current inventory is a fixed ceiling that fully defines the obligation.
changed_reading.after: Actual means still calibrate the obligation, but the assessment asks what can genuinely sustain housing and care rather than allowing a closed forecast to disguise reachable provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeats the pregnancy-load and placing-down sequence, then names an opening into ease; the next ayah magnifies recompense. This sharpens delivery as decompression of one burden-state and nursing pay as the acknowledged value of a new service, not an unpaid continuation of pregnancy support.

activation_trace.role: The inner pregnancy load defines the state whose material support continues to delivery.
Putting down the pregnancy load marks the transition rather than erasing subsequent care work.
A named wage assigns independent value to nursing after the gestational phase.
Opening and facility after hardship casts the load's endpoint as a transition into a workable next arrangement.
Magnitude resists a minimizing frame for recompense in the immediately adjacent context.

structural_cues: 65:4 repeats أولات الأحمال, أجل, يضعن, and حمل before ending in ease.
65:5 ends by magnifying recompense, while 65:6 gives the nursing woman her explicit wage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact load-release repetition, ease after difficulty, and magnified recompense; I infer a transition from one supported bodily state to a separately valued labor state. A live alternative is that 65:5's recompense is solely divine reward and offers only an analogy, not a direct rule for wage size.

changed_reading.before: Delivery ends pregnancy maintenance, after which nursing is a loosely related family service.
changed_reading.after: Delivery decompresses one burden-state but opens another care economy: nursing is newly assigned labor whose compensation must not be absorbed into or minimized by the prior support arrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah opposes amplitude to constriction, makes spending track each, forbids imposing beyond what was given, and moves from hardship toward ease. Together with the focus ban on harming and narrowing, this yields a two-sided non-crushing rule: no engineered deprivation of the recipient and no fictive limitless capacity imposed on the payer.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing livelihood anchors the recipient-facing prohibition against strategic scarcity.
Actual financial ability supplies the focus-side calibration point.
Breadth of power and endurance sets the upper mode of proportionate spending.
Breadth of wealth and livelihood grounds that power in material circumstances.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the lower-capacity case without cancelling expenditure.
Imposing a difficult burden limits what may be demanded beyond genuinely given capacity.
Opening after hardship makes workable continuity, rather than victory by either party, the directional endpoint.

structural_cues: 65:7 repeats the spending command once for amplitude and once for constricted provision.
Its no-burden-beyond-giving clause and hardship-to-ease close follow the focus prohibition on harm and constriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wide capacity, restricted provision, imposed burden, and ease after hardship; I infer a symmetric guardrail because 65:6 directly protects the recipient while 65:7 limits demands to what was given. A live alternative emphasizes only payer relief, but it leaves the focus anti-constriction clause underexplained.

changed_reading.before: The focus either protects the woman through open-ended support or protects the payer through a means-tested ceiling.
changed_reading.after: The two ayat jointly prevent crushing either side: support cannot be throttled into coercion, and its calibrated amount cannot pretend that constrained means are unlimited.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command-accounting-consequence sequence makes it harder to treat the focus imperatives as optional private generosity. Housing, non-harm, spending, wages, and consultation become a small accountable order whose failures leave weight and loss rather than remaining invisible domestic discretion.

activation_trace.role: Obligating direction remains present inside the focus even though one verb also carries mutual consultation.
The explicit wage gives accountability a concrete, transferable object.
Reckoning makes response to command inspectable rather than lost in private intention.
Harmful weight supplies the material feel of consequences produced by failed ordering.
The end-result branch directs attention from immediate bargaining advantage to the arrangement's later outcome.
General loss names the net result when command is converted into self-serving discretion.

structural_cues: 65:8-9 repeat أمر while moving from resistance to accounting, experienced consequence, outcome, and loss.
The focus itself is a dense chain of imperatives interrupted only to specify conditions and failover.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communal resistance to command, reckoning, weight, consequence, and loss; I infer by repeated أمر and sequence that the focus household duties participate in an accountable order. A live alternative is that the later communal warning supplies only moral atmosphere and no procedural implication for the household clauses.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers prudent private advice for reducing conflict after divorce.
changed_reading.after: Its shelter, maintenance, compensation, and consultation commands form an accountable domestic order whose downstream harms and losses matter beyond either party's immediate preference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later movement out of darkness into light and into a sustaining interior revises residence away from static confinement. Focus housing is a protective station whose success is measured by livable passage through separation, while deliberate narrowing turns that station back into darkness.

activation_trace.role: An inhabited home gives the transitional passage a stable station.
Spatial incapacity marks the point at which protection becomes confining pressure.
Passage to an exterior supplies directional movement rather than forced stasis.
Illumination supplies exposed safety and intelligibility as the quality of the destination.
Entry into a new interior completes the pattern of protected movement between states.

structural_cues: 65:11 forms a spatial chain from darkness, through خروج, toward light, then دخول into gardens.
65:6 combines settled residence with an explicit ban on making its interior too narrow to bear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exit, illumination, and entry as a transformed spatial sequence; I infer analogically that focus housing should enable a safe transition rather than immobilize the woman. A live alternative confines 65:11 to eschatological movement and denies any household-scale spatial echo.

changed_reading.before: Keeping the woman housed chiefly means preventing her movement during a prescribed interval.
changed_reading.after: Settled housing is a protected passage through a vulnerable interval; it fails its function when confinement, darkness, or narrowing replaces habitable stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the surah's close, command descends 'between' layered worlds so that knowledge can become manifest within comprehensive awareness. This activates the focus 'between you' as a medium, not an empty gap: consultation is where obligation is translated into knowable housing, wage, and care arrangements.

activation_trace.role: The interval between two parties supplies the relational space in which the arrangement must operate.
A remaining connection across that interval lets separated parties coordinate care.
Mutual deliberation is the focus-side operation performed in the between-space.
Delivery downward supplies the image of an order reaching and traversing distinct levels.
Disclosure to a knower makes intelligibility, not bare transmission, the endpoint of descent.
Complete encompassing knowledge places local arrangements inside a wider field of accountability.

structural_cues: 65:12 places الأمر immediately before بينهن in the descending sequence.
65:6 places reciprocal deliberation immediately before بينكم and then gives a concrete contingency plan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command descending between layers toward knowledge and comprehensive awareness; I infer a scale analogy in which consultation delivers obligation into concrete relations. A live alternative treats the shared بين syntax as incidental and keeps the cosmic and household scales wholly separate.

changed_reading.before: 'Between you' merely names the two people who should discuss nursing.
changed_reading.after: The between-space is itself the delivery medium where general obligation becomes a visible, intelligible, and accountable care arrangement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant و ل ي mapping behind ء و ل and must not be presented as the lexical gloss of أولات. It remains anchored in the repeated أولات/أولي construction, the explicit pregnancy category, and its support consequences; downstream prose should call it a branch-activated status or priority layer, not a translation claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أولات حمل identifies the pregnancy-bearing women immediately before the command to spend on them until delivery.

activation_trace.role: Priority and entitlement turn pregnancy from a descriptive trait into a possible claim-triggering status.
The actual interior load supplies the bodily condition to which that possible priority attaches.
Directed maintenance is the concrete consequence of recognizing the condition.
The later أولي construction keeps a class-defining possession pattern active across the surah.

changed_reading.before: Pregnancy is a factual exception that merely extends maintenance until birth.
changed_reading.after: Pregnancy may function as a priority-conferring status: the embodied load reorders claims on available resources until its specified transition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant و ج د to ج د د mapping and its image of water or milk drying up; it must not redefine وجد as lactation failure. It remains worth carrying because the same focus ayah joins means, depleting expenditure, nursing, and an alternate nurse; downstream prose should render it only as a supply-failure analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The means clause feeds a sequence of expenditure and nursing that ends with another nursing provider if the first coordination route fails.

activation_trace.role: Interruption of water or milk supplies a vivid failure mode for a support channel that can cease.
Depletion makes finite material supply part of the same failure-sensitive system.
Milk transfer is the care flow that the final alternate-provider clause explicitly preserves.
The other provider embodies rerouting when the primary human channel cannot be sustained.

changed_reading.before: Means concerns money, while alternate nursing concerns interpersonal disagreement.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can also be modeled as failure-aware provisioning: financial or lactational channels may run dry, so care must be calibrated and reroutable rather than allowed to stop.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ship-steering branch is a cross-domain image and not a claim that سكن in the ayah literally denotes a rudder. It remains anchored by the doubled س ك ن, the adjacent crowding and constriction prohibitions, and the need to stabilize a separated household; downstream prose should mark it as a material systems analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Cause them to dwell where you dwell, while neither crowding nor narrowing them into instability.

activation_trace.role: A ship's steering piece that quiets oscillation supplies a dynamic image of housing as active stabilization.
Crowding and pressed nearness identify one force that can destabilize the shared residential field.
Insufficient room names the spatial condition the stabilizing arrangement must counteract.
A maintained connection between separated parties gives the steering analogy its social system.

changed_reading.before: Housing is a stationary container assigned during the waiting period.
changed_reading.after: Housing can be carried as a stabilizing control surface that damps post-separation oscillation while keeping the care system on course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The broken-bone branch of ء ج ر is branch-distant from ordinary wages and cannot replace the direct remuneration sense. It remains anchored by explicit أجر, separation, reciprocal obstruction, and the need for care to continue without restored marriage; downstream prose should present payment-as-splint only as a functional analogy that permits imperfect repair.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Give nursing women their wages, deliberate under recognized good, and preserve nursing through another provider when cooperation fractures.

activation_trace.role: Setting a fracture even when it heals with some crookedness supplies repair without pretending the prior union is restored.
The direct wage sense keeps the analogy tied to an actual compensatory transfer.
Mutual twisting supplies the relational fracture that compensation and failover must bridge.
Actual separation prevents the repair image from collapsing into reconciliation or reunion.

changed_reading.before: The wage closes a discrete labor account between former spouses.
changed_reading.after: Payment can also function like a splint across a fractured cooperation interface: it supports continued infant care even when the relationship remains separated and imperfect.

strongest_changes: Housing changed from nominal accommodation into active stabilization whose livability is defeated by coercive narrowing.
Pregnancy support, delivery, nursing, wages, and alternate nursing became a load-and-labor transfer chain with built-in failover.
Consultation changed from private cordiality into a norm-governed, reviewable procedure that can survive separation.
Capacity became a two-sided non-crushing calibration: finite means matter, but scarcity may not be engineered into leverage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaves like a compact resilient system: it stabilizes space, routes finite resources toward embodied load and paid care, constrains bargaining, and switches providers when cooperation fails. Split-root images added live but contained readings of pregnancy as priority status and interrupted money or milk as a supply failure, while material branches recast housing as steering and wages as a splint across separation.
remaining_uncertainties: How formally the witnessed and just procedure of 65:2 governs nursing agreements in 65:6 remains inferential.
The future-preserving function of residence is stronger than a bare procedural reading but is not explicitly named as its purpose.
The 65:11 passage and 65:12 between-space models depend on cross-scale analogy and should remain secondary.
The و ج د to ج د د and ء و ل to و ل ي outliers are packet-authorized split-root activations, not lexical substitutions.
